text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Undersecretary of oil says Iraq is ready to handle possible increase of Iraqi oil production.
- Iraqi athletes stage protest in the Syrian-Lebanese borders.
-Syria to hold medical exhibition in Iraq at the end of this month.
-American troops prevent a United Arab Emirates vessel loaded with donated medicine from sailing to Iraq.
-Editorial lashing out at Kuwait and Saudi Arabia for pressing on Lebanon not to grant visas to Iraqi athletes.
(The above except the oil story and the editorial were also carried by QADISSIYA and IRAQ)
